title: Data Gathering
text: In this section, we gather job market news data using the NewsAPI. The goal is to collect recent articles related to hiring, employment, and the job market to analyze trends over time.

title: Data Gathering
text:
Setup
We use the following Python libraries:

requests — to call the NewsAPI
pandas — to store and organize the data


import requests
import pandas as pd

title: Data Gathering
text:
API Connection
We connect to the NewsAPI using our API key and search for articles related to the job market.

API_KEY = "9d9a703569914e82a61aa211e31ddba1"
url = "https://newsapi.org/v2/everything"

params = {
    "q": "job market hiring employment",
    "language": "en",
    "sortBy": "publishedAt",
    "pageSize": 100,
    "apiKey": API_KEY
}

response = requests.get(url, params=params)
data = response.json()

print("Status:", data["status"])
print("Total articles found:", data["totalResults"])

Status: ok
Total articles found: 300

title: Data Gathering
text:
Load into DataFrame
We load the articles into a pandas DataFrame for easy analysis.

articles = data["articles"]
df = pd.DataFrame(articles)

print("Shape:", df.shape)
df.head()

Shape: (97, 8)
